ev.q: This report summarizes data from the NYTS on current use of tobacco products
Percentage of students in middle school (grades 6-8) and high school (grades 9-12) currently* using tobacco products
Among middle school (grades 6-8) students, the overall prevalence of any current tobacco use was 12.8%
Boys were significantly more likely than girls to use smokeless tobacco (4.2% and 1.3%, respectively)
The school-based 1999 NYTS employed a three-stage cluster sample designed to produce a nationally representative sample
surveillance of trends in tobacco use among youth must be continued and expanded

methods_quotes.q: Differences between prevalence estimates were considered statistically significant if the 95% confidence intervals did not overlap.
SUDAAN was used to compute 95% confidence intervals
A weighting factor was applied to each student record to adjust for nonresponse and for the varying probabilities of selection
